summary: Northern Oil and Gas, Inc. filed an 8-K on May 22, 2026, announcing a definitive asset purchase agreement for Canadian oil and gas assets from Parallax Energy Operating Inc. through a wholly owned subsidiary. Total consideration is CA$237M cash plus CA$113M in Northern common stock, with additional contingent consideration of up to CA$25M tied to WTI crude pricing. A CA$37.5M deposit was placed in escrow. Closing is subject to customary conditions. The acquisition expands Northern's Canadian presence; watch for regulatory approvals and commodity price sensitivity affecting the contingent component.
